mistake_reason: At step 13, Assistant redefined the verification criterion to use 'earliest Date Added' instead of 'earliest Release Year' to determine the 'oldest Blu-Ray,' despite the spreadsheet explicitly showing the earliest Blu-Ray by Release Year as 'Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe'. This constitutes Incorrect Verification (FM-3.3): they failed to adequately validate the correct interpretation of 'oldest', applied a flawed and irrelevant criterion, and falsely signed off 'Time-Parking' as correct. The verification logic produced a false positive and ignored contradictory evidence in the same dataset.
